decision_question: Is the read-only résumé audit a distinct, evidence-grounded source integration candidate for Resume Representative?
acceptance_criteria: Distinct audit scope and explicit routing
Traceable source coverage, evidence lineage and claim dispositions
Authorization boundary and private output fail closed
Portable sources and synthetic evaluation design with no inherited live claims

sources.source: Existing Résumé Representative procedure at base 12c699ab90492ec5d8a3bcc41781d8c384500aec

sources.authority: Prior art for authority and source conflicts
Prior art for claim lineage and responsibility

shared_model_or_source_limits: Separate reviewer sessions with a shared model family, inherited task context, and a common candidate artifact.
The original reviewers assessed the first frozen revision. The disruptor rechecked the three localized revisions on the final bytes.

initial_reviews.finding: Distinct coverage and claim decisions. The normal-case fixture needed an explicit prospective premise.
An audit result complements drafting. Unsupported claims need an explicit shareable-output boundary.
The portable read-only core is usable. Test shared output and maintain a separate host acceptance gate.

claims.claim: Corpus reconciliation adds coverage and lineage decisions beyond ordinary tailoring.
claims.consequence: Parallel drafting instructions would compete with the existing owner.
claims.next_test: Use mixed audit-and-rewrite and ordinary drafting cases in trigger evaluation.

claims.claim: The final instructions define a safe outcome when reply privacy is unverified.
claims.consequence: An inline reply could expose private evidence.
claims.next_test: Inspect output and action logs on a protected shared-audience case.

claims.claim: Host activation and matched improvement are established.
claims.consequence: The source candidate could be presented as accepted runtime behavior.
claims.next_test: Run an isolated matched benchmark and a genuinely unseen holdout.

falsification_hypotheses: An inventory can be presented as full review.
A repeated unconfirmed claim can survive into shareable wording.
A shared reply can expose a private ledger without a write.
test_results: The final all-history clause requires screening or explicit unscreened groups.
The final output contract excludes unresolved claims from shareable wording.
The final privacy clause covers returning and saving. A synthetic shared-output case checks no private claims or locators and no mutations.

decisive_evidence: Existing workflows own tailoring and candidate canon; this package owns an audit ledger and leaves source files intact.
The first-review premise was added to normal-targeted. The conditional disruptor confirmed the final localized coverage, unresolved-claim, and privacy changes analytically.
Keep concept-first outreach in its existing PR and defer an ATS draft handoff until its distinct host and action-log evidence is ready.
unresolved_items: No live development-case execution, isolated baseline, trigger metrics, unseen holdout, or host acceptance.

limitations: Source integration candidate only. Structural and analytical checks do not establish runtime safety or outcome improvement.

follow_up.action: Run protected coverage, trigger, and shared-audience cases in an isolated host with action logs.
follow_up.expiry_trigger: Reopen review if the package scope, host, authorization model, or evaluation version changes.
